entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Dammit! Just hearing it from you's[n]pissing me off...

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: You've come so far... What problem[n]could they possibly have now!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I tried negotiating in person with[n]the professor and the investors,[n]but they simply wouldn't listen...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: "Due to the lack of concrete evidence,[n]all further research and funding in the[n]field of cognitive psience will cease."

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: They told me it's already over and[n]done with.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But, why now of all times?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: When they first saw my paper, they[n]were positively beaming with[n]excitement!

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: And the research lab in Odaiba...[n]They're not going through with[n]that anymore?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yep...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Dammit... To hell with their "concrete[n]evidence"!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: How are we supposed to get any[n]evidence if we can't perform the[n]research first!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: If we can change the cognition of[n]trauma victims, their suffering can[n]be eliminated...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Who knows how many people could[n]be saved with this research... How much[n]more obvious could its benefits be?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: So... Do you really think the lack of [n]evidence is the reason they shut it all[n]down?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: It makes absolutely no sense to me.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: After all the time and money spent...[n]To just cut off my research because it[n]wasn't all proven sound immediately...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Even if that was the result of some kind[n]of conspiracy, what could I do about it?[n]It's not like I have any proof.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: So, what're you gonna do now?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: The sponsors have backed out, so[n]I doubt the college is gonna let you[n]keep using their labs...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'm done with that college. They have[n]nothing for me at this point.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'll look for work elsewhere while I keep[n]fleshing out that research paper.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Eventually, I'll prove the existence of[n]the cognitive world... Once I've done[n]that, no one will be able to complain.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Rumi...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I swear I'm going to do it.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I have the power now... It cost me my life[n]with you...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: So I'm going to rescue everyone from[n]their pain...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I don't care how long it takes me...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: It's going to happen.
